questions.stem: If \(A = \{1, 2, 3\}\), then the number of equivalence relation for \((1, 2)\) is :

hi.solution:
समुच्चय \(A = \{1, 2, 3\}\) पर अवयव \((1, 2)\) वाला तुल्यता संबंध स्वतुल्य होना चाहिए, अतः उसमें \((1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3)\) होंगे, और सममित होना चाहिए, अतः उसमें \((2, 1)\) भी होगा। ऐसा सबसे छोटा संबंध \(R_1 = \{(1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3), (1, 2), (2, 1)\}\) है, जो संक्रामक भी है। इसमें कोई और युग्म, जैसे \((2, 3)\), जोड़ने पर सममिति और संक्रामकता के कारण \((3, 2), (1, 3), (3, 1)\) भी जोड़ने पड़ते हैं, जिससे सार्वत्रिक संबंध \(R_2 = A \times A\) प्राप्त होता है। अतः ऐसे तुल्यता संबंध केवल दो हैं, जो विकल्प 2 है।

questions.solution:
An equivalence relation on the set \(A = \{1, 2, 3\}\) that contains \((1, 2)\) must be reflexive, so it contains \((1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3)\), and symmetric, so it also contains \((2, 1)\). The smallest such relation is \(R_1 = \{(1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3), (1, 2), (2, 1)\}\), which is also transitive. If any further pair, say \((2, 3)\), is added, symmetry and transitivity force \((3, 2), (1, 3), (3, 1)\) as well, which gives the universal relation \(R_2 = A \times A\). So there are exactly two such equivalence relations, which is the choice 2.

When a die is thrown twice, the sample space has \(6 \times 6 = 36\) equally likely outcomes.
Let \(F\) be the event that the sum of the numbers is 6: \(F = \{(1, 5), (2, 4), (3, 3), (4, 2), (5, 1)\}\), so \(P(F) = \frac{5}{36}\).

The required conditional probability is
\(P(E/F) = \frac{P(E \cap F)}{P(F)} = \frac{2/36}{5/36} = \frac{2}{5}\).

questions.stem: If vectors \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}, \vec{c}\) are mutually perpendicular and having equal magnitude, then show that the vector \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}\) is equally inclined to the vectors \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}, \vec{c}\).

hi.stem: यदि \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}, \vec{c}\) समान परिमाणवाले परस्पर लंबवत सदिश हैं, तो दर्शाइए कि सदिश \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}\) सदिशों \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}\) तथा \(\vec{c}\) के साथ बराबर झुका हुआ है।
hi.solution:
माना \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = |\vec{c}| = k\)। चूँकि सदिश परस्पर लम्बवत हैं, अतः \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} = \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = 0\)।
तब \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}|^2 = |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = k^2 + k^2 + k^2 + 0 = 3k^2\), अतः \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}| = \sqrt{3}k\)।
माना सदिश \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}\), सदिशों \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}, \vec{c}\) के साथ क्रमशः कोण \(\alpha, \beta, \gamma\) बनाता है।
\(\cos\alpha = \frac{(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot \vec{a}}{|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}||\vec{a}|} = \frac{|\vec{a}|^2 + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}}{\sqrt{3}k \cdot k} = \frac{k^2}{\sqrt{3}k^2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\)।
इसी प्रकार \(\cos\beta = \frac{(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot \vec{b}}{\sqrt{3}k \cdot k} = \frac{k^2}{\sqrt{3}k^2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) तथा \(\cos\gamma = \frac{(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot \vec{c}}{\sqrt{3}k \cdot k} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\)।
अतः \(\alpha = \beta = \gamma = \cos^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\), अर्थात् सदिश \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}\), सदिशों \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}\) तथा \(\vec{c}\) के साथ बराबर झुका हुआ है। इति सिद्धम्।

Let \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = |\vec{c}| = k\). Since the vectors are mutually perpendicular, \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} = \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = 0\).
Then \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}|^2 = |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = k^2 + k^2 + k^2 + 0 = 3k^2\), so \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}| = \sqrt{3}k\).
Let \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}\) make angles \(\alpha, \beta, \gamma\) with \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}, \vec{c}\) respectively.
\(\cos\alpha = \frac{(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot \vec{a}}{|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}||\vec{a}|} = \frac{|\vec{a}|^2 + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}}{\sqrt{3}k \cdot k} = \frac{k^2}{\sqrt{3}k^2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).

questions.stem: Find the area of the circle \(x^2 + y^2 = r^2\)

hi.stem: वृत्त \(x^2 + y^2 = r^2\) का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
hi.solution:
वृत्त \(x^2 + y^2 = r^2\) का केन्द्र मूलबिन्दु तथा त्रिज्या \(r\) है, और यह दोनों अक्षों के सापेक्ष सममित है। अतः इसका क्षेत्रफल, प्रथम चतुर्थांश में वक्र, \(x\)-अक्ष तथा कोटियों \(x = 0\) और \(x = r\) से घिरे भाग के क्षेत्रफल का 4 गुना है।
प्रथम चतुर्थांश में \(y = \sqrt{r^2 - x^2}\)। अतः
क्षेत्रफल \(= 4\int_0^r \sqrt{r^2 - x^2} \, dx = 4\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{r^2 - x^2} + \frac{r^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{r}\right]_0^r\)
\(= 4\left[\left(\frac{r}{2} \cdot 0 + \frac{r^2}{2}\sin^{-1}1\right) - (0 + 0)\right] = 4 \cdot \frac{r^2}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} = \pi r^2\)।
अतः वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल \(\pi r^2\) वर्ग इकाई है।

*हल PYQ Vault द्वारा: यूपी बोर्ड उत्तर कुंजी प्रकाशित नहीं करता।*

questions.solution:
The circle \(x^2 + y^2 = r^2\) has centre at the origin and radius \(r\), and is symmetric about both axes. So its area is 4 times the area of the part in the first quadrant, bounded by the curve, the \(x\)-axis and the ordinates \(x = 0\) and \(x = r\).
In the first quadrant \(y = \sqrt{r^2 - x^2}\). So
Area \(= 4\int_0^r \sqrt{r^2 - x^2} \, dx = 4\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{r^2 - x^2} + \frac{r^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{r}\right]_0^r\)
\(= 4\left[\left(\frac{r}{2} \cdot 0 + \frac{r^2}{2}\sin^{-1}1\right) - (0 + 0)\right] = 4 \cdot \frac{r^2}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} = \pi r^2\).
So the area of the circle is \(\pi r^2\) square units.

questions.stem: If \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -3 & 5 \\ 3 & 2 & -4 \\ 1 & 1 & -2 \end{bmatrix}\) then find \(A^{-1}\).

hi.stem: यदि \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -3 & 5 \\ 3 & 2 & -4 \\ 1 & 1 & -2 \end{bmatrix}\) हो, तो \(A^{-1}\) ज्ञात कीजिए।

Here \(|A| = 2\begin{vmatrix} 2 & -4 \\ 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix} - (-3)\begin{vmatrix} 3 & -4 \\ 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix} + 5\begin{vmatrix} 3 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = 2(-4 + 4) + 3(-6 + 4) + 5(3 - 2) = 0 - 6 + 5 = -1\).
Since \(|A| \neq 0\), \(A^{-1}\) exists.
The cofactors \(A_{ij}\) of the elements are:
\(A_{11} = (-4 + 4) = 0\), \(A_{12} = -(-6 + 4) = 2\), \(A_{13} = (3 - 2) = 1\)
\(A_{21} = -(6 - 5) = -1\), \(A_{22} = (-4 - 5) = -9\), \(A_{23} = -(2 + 3) = -5\)
\(A_{31} = (12 - 10) = 2\), \(A_{32} = -(-8 - 15) = 23\), \(A_{33} = (4 + 9) = 13\)
So \(\text{adj} A = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 & 2 \\ 2 & -9 & 23 \\ 1 & -5 & 13 \end{bmatrix}\) (the transpose of the matrix of cofactors).
Therefore \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{|A|}\text{adj} A = \frac{1}{-1}\begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 & 2 \\ 2 & -9 & 23 \\ 1 & -5 & 13 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 & -2 \\ -2 & 9 & -23 \\ -1 & 5 & -13 \end{bmatrix}\).
(Check: multiplying the matrix \(A\) by this matrix gives \(I\); for example the first row of \(A\) times the first column is \(0 + 6 - 5 = 1\).)

questions.stem:
Solve the system of Linear Equations by Matrix Method
\(2x + 3y + 3z = 5\)
\(x - 2y + z = -4\)
\(3x - y - 2z = 3\)

hi.stem:
समीकरण निकाय
\(2x + 3y + 3z = 5\)
\(x - 2y + z = -4\)
\(3x - y - 2z = 3\) को आव्यूह विधि से हल कीजिए।

questions.solution:
The system can be written as \(AX = B\), where
\(A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 3 & 3 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 \\ 3 & -1 & -2 \end{bmatrix}\), \(X = \begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{bmatrix}\), \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 5 \\ -4 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix}\).
\(|A| = 2(4 + 1) - 3(-2 - 3) + 3(-1 + 6) = 10 + 15 + 15 = 40 \neq 0\), so the matrix \(A\) is non-singular and the system has a unique solution \(X = A^{-1}B\).
Cofactors:
\(A_{11} = 4 + 1 = 5\), \(A_{12} = -(-2 - 3) = 5\), \(A_{13} = -1 + 6 = 5\)
\(A_{21} = -(-6 + 3) = 3\), \(A_{22} = -4 - 9 = -13\), \(A_{23} = -(-2 - 9) = 11\)
\(A_{31} = 3 + 6 = 9\), \(A_{32} = -(2 - 3) = 1\), \(A_{33} = -4 - 3 = -7\)
So \(\text{adj} A = \begin{bmatrix} 5 & 3 & 9 \\ 5 & -13 & 1 \\ 5 & 11 & -7 \end{bmatrix}\) and \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{40}\begin{bmatrix} 5 & 3 & 9 \\ 5 & -13 & 1 \\ 5 & 11 & -7 \end{bmatrix}\).
Then \(X = A^{-1}B = \frac{1}{40}\begin{bmatrix} 25 - 12 + 27 \\ 25 + 52 + 3 \\ 25 - 44 - 21 \end{bmatrix} = \frac{1}{40}\begin{bmatrix} 40 \\ 80 \\ -40 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \\ -1 \end{bmatrix}\).
Hence \(x = 1, y = 2, z = -1\).
(Check: \(2 + 6 - 3 = 5\), \(1 - 4 - 1 = -4\), \(3 - 2 + 2 = 3\).)

questions.stem: Prove that the radius of the largest (maximum surface area) right circular cylinder that can be inscribed in a cone is half of the radius of the cone.

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि एक शंकु के अंतर्गत महत्तम वक्र पृष्ठ वाले लम्ब वृत्तीय बेलन की त्रिज्या शंकु की त्रिज्या की आधी होती है।
hi.solution:
**टिप्पणी:** अंग्रेज़ी प्रश्न में महत्तम पृष्ठ क्षेत्रफल वाला बेलन पूछा गया है, जबकि हिंदी प्रश्न में महत्तम वक्र पृष्ठ वाला; बेलन की त्रिज्या शंकु की त्रिज्या की आधी केवल वक्र पृष्ठ के लिए आती है, अतः हल हिंदी प्रश्न के अनुसार किया गया है।
माना दिए गए शंकु के आधार की त्रिज्या \(R\) तथा ऊँचाई \(H\) है, और इसके अंतर्गत \(r\) त्रिज्या तथा \(h\) ऊँचाई का एक लम्ब वृत्तीय बेलन बना है, जिसका आधार शंकु के आधार पर है (\(0 < r < R\))।
अक्ष से होकर जाने वाले ऊर्ध्वाधर परिच्छेद में, बेलन के ऊपरी तल के ऊपर का छोटा त्रिभुज (ऊँचाई \(H - h\), आधी भुजा \(r\)) पूरे त्रिभुज (ऊँचाई \(H\), आधी भुजा \(R\)) के समरूप है। अतः
\(\frac{H - h}{H} = \frac{r}{R} \Rightarrow h = \frac{H(R - r)}{R}\)।
बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठ
\(S = 2\pi r h = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(Rr - r^2)\)।
\(r\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dS}{dr} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(R - 2r)\)।
उच्चिष्ठ अथवा निम्निष्ठ के लिए \(\frac{dS}{dr} = 0 \Rightarrow R - 2r = 0 \Rightarrow r = \frac{R}{2}\)।
पुनः \(\frac{d^2S}{dr^2} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(-2) = -\frac{4\pi H}{R} < 0\), अतः \(r = \frac{R}{2}\) पर \(S\) महत्तम है।
अतः शंकु के अंतर्गत महत्तम वक्र पृष्ठ वाले लम्ब वृत्तीय बेलन की त्रिज्या शंकु की त्रिज्या की आधी होती है। इति सिद्धम्।

*हल PYQ Vault द्वारा: यूपी बोर्ड उत्तर कुंजी प्रकाशित नहीं करता।*

questions._flag: The Hindi says maximum CURVED surface (वक्र पृष्ठ) where the English says maximum surface area; a stamp crosses लम्ब in the Hindi, read as right (circular) from the English.
questions.solution:
**Note:** The English print asks for the cylinder of maximum surface area, while the Hindi print asks for maximum curved surface; the radius comes out as half the cone's radius only for the curved surface, so the working follows the Hindi print.
Let the given cone have base radius \(R\) and height \(H\), and let a right circular cylinder of radius \(r\) and height \(h\) be inscribed in it, with its base on the base of the cone (\(0 < r < R\)).
In the vertical section through the axis, the small triangle above the top of the cylinder (height \(H - h\), half-base \(r\)) is similar to the whole triangle (height \(H\), half-base \(R\)). So
\(\frac{H - h}{H} = \frac{r}{R} \Rightarrow h = \frac{H(R - r)}{R}\).
The curved surface area of the cylinder is
\(S = 2\pi r h = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(Rr - r^2)\).
Differentiating with respect to \(r\):
\(\frac{dS}{dr} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(R - 2r)\).
For a maximum or minimum, \(\frac{dS}{dr} = 0 \Rightarrow R - 2r = 0 \Rightarrow r = \frac{R}{2}\).
Again, \(\frac{d^2S}{dr^2} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(-2) = -\frac{4\pi H}{R} < 0\), so \(S\) is maximum at \(r = \frac{R}{2}\).
Hence the radius of the inscribed right circular cylinder of greatest curved surface is half the radius of the cone. Hence proved.

questions.stem: Evaluate : \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx\)

hi.stem: \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
hi.solution:
माना \(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx\) ...(1)
गुणधर्म \(\int_0^a f(x) \, dx = \int_0^a f(a - x) \, dx\) से:
\(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right) dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \cos x \, dx\) ...(2)
(1) तथा (2) को जोड़ने पर:
\(2I = \int_0^{\pi/2} (\log \sin x + \log \cos x) \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log(\sin x \cos x) \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\left(\frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right) dx\)
\(= \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx - \int_0^{\pi/2} \log 2 \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\) ...(3)
\(I_1 = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx\) में \(2x = t\) रखने पर \(dx = \frac{dt}{2}\); जब \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\) तथा जब \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t = \pi\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi} \log \sin t \, dt\)।
चूँकि \(\log \sin(\pi - t) = \log \sin t\), अतः गुणधर्म \(\int_0^{2a} f(t) \, dt = 2\int_0^a f(t) \, dt\) से:
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin t \, dt = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx = I\)।
इसे (3) में रखने पर: \(2I = I - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\), अतः
\(I = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\)।
अतः \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2 = \frac{\pi}{2}\log\frac{1}{2}\)।

*हल PYQ Vault द्वारा: यूपी बोर्ड उत्तर कुंजी प्रकाशित नहीं करता।*

questions.solution:
Let \(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx\) ...(1)
Using \(\int_0^a f(x) \, dx = \int_0^a f(a - x) \, dx\):
\(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right) dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \cos x \, dx\) ...(2)
Adding (1) and (2):
\(2I = \int_0^{\pi/2} (\log \sin x + \log \cos x) \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log(\sin x \cos x) \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\left(\frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right) dx\)
\(= \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx - \int_0^{\pi/2} \log 2 \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\) ...(3)
In \(I_1 = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx\), put \(2x = t\), so \(dx = \frac{dt}{2}\); when \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\) and when \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t = \pi\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi} \log \sin t \, dt\).
Since \(\log \sin(\pi - t) = \log \sin t\), using \(\int_0^{2a} f(t) \, dt = 2\int_0^a f(t) \, dt\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin t \, dt = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx = I\).
Putting this in (3): \(2I = I - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\), so
\(I = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\).
So \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2 = \frac{\pi}{2}\log\frac{1}{2}\).

questions.stem: Find the value of \(\int_0^{\pi} \frac{x \, dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\)

hi.stem: \(\int_0^{\pi} \frac{x \, dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
hi.solution:
माना \(a, b > 0\) तथा \(I = \int_0^{\pi} \frac{x \, dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) ...(1)
गुणधर्म \(\int_0^a f(x) \, dx = \int_0^a f(a - x) \, dx\) से, तथा \(\cos^2(\pi - x) = \cos^2 x\), \(\sin^2(\pi - x) = \sin^2 x\) होने से:
\(I = \int_0^{\pi} \frac{(\pi - x) \, dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) ...(2)
(1) तथा (2) को जोड़ने पर:
\(2I = \pi\int_0^{\pi} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)।
\(x\) के स्थान पर \(\pi - x\) रखने पर समाकल्य अपरिवर्तित रहता है, अतः गुणधर्म \(\int_0^{2a} f(x) \, dx = 2\int_0^a f(x) \, dx\) से:
\(2I = 2\pi\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\), अर्थात् \(I = \pi\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)।
अंश और हर को \(\cos^2 x\) से भाग देने पर:
\(I = \pi\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{\sec^2 x \, dx}{a^2 + b^2\tan^2 x}\)।
